title: The Ice Chimes
text: Icicles hang in the cave mouth like the pipes of an organ, long and blue, chiming in the wind. Their slow, sad tune is almost a voice. If you stand still and listen, it seems to be calling someone home.

options.label: Stop and listen to the chimes, that they might sing you home.

outcomes.text: It is a lullaby, slow and sad. You rest more deeply than you have in days.
It is a song of the frozen dead, begging you to lie down among them. Refusing is very hard.

options.label: The strongest breaks the chimes before their song calls anyone else.

outcomes.text: Silence falls, sudden and total. Something deeper in the cave wakes to it, wanting its music back.

options.label: The wisest hums the tune back to them, asking the chimes the way.

outcomes.text: The chimes answer note for note; their song points the way onward.
